items.text: On this album he plays the cavaquinho for the first time, an instrument he had dropped for the guitar.
items.why: "pela primeira vez, Nelson tocou cavaquinho, instrumento que havia abandonando pelo violão". The pack ties this to the choro "Caminhando", which the hook does not name.

items.text: Some of the samba musician's songs were recorded on this LP, among them 'Juízo Final', 'Folhas Secas', 'A Flor e o Espinho', 'Rugas' and 'Quando Eu Me Chamar Saudade'.
items.why: "foram gravados algumas das melhores composições do sambista, como Juízo Final, Folhas Secas, A Flor e o Espinho, Rugas e Quando Eu Me Chamar Saudade". Titles match the Disco section; "melhores" was dropped, which is safe.

items.text: Guilherme de Brito is a special guest on this track.

missed: The cavaquinho is played on the choro "Caminhando" (Disco), the obvious listen_for item; the notes never name it. Also that this is his third album.
